SELECT 
    p.panemark,
    pl.initdate,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), pl.initdate))::int AS panel_age,
    perf.measpoww,
    p.powratew,
    env.soillosspct,
    (perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric AS cumdegpct,
    ROUND(CAST(perf.measpoww AS numeric) / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * 100, 2) AS ppr
FROM panel p
JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
JOIN performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref
JOIN environment env ON pl.growregistry = env.arearegistry
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    p.panemark,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), pl.initdate))::int AS panel_age,
    ROUND(CAST(perf.measpoww AS numeric) / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * 100, 2) AS ppr,
    env.soillosspct,
    (perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric AS cumdegpct,
    ROUND(
        CAST(perf.measpoww AS numeric) / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * 100 
        * (1 - env.soillosspct / 100) 
        * (1 - (perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100), 
    2) AS adjusted_ppr,
    ROUND(0.9 * (100 - 0.7 * EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), pl.initdate))::int), 2) AS threshold,
    CASE WHEN 
        CAST(perf.measpoww AS numeric) / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * 100 
        * (1 - env.soillosspct / 100) 
        * (1 - (perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100)
        < 0.9 * (100 - 0.7 * EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), pl.initdate))::int)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS warranty_eligible_flag
FROM panel p
JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
JOIN performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref
JOIN environment env ON pl.growregistry = env.arearegistry
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), pl.initdate))::int AS panel_age,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(perf.measpoww AS numeric) / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric)) * 100, 2) AS avg_metric,
    COUNT(*) AS num_panels,
    SUM(CASE WHEN 
        CAST(perf.measpoww AS numeric) / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * 100 
        * (1 - env.soillosspct / 100) 
        * (1 - (perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100)
        < 0.9 * (100 - 0.7 * EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), pl.initdate))::int)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warranty_eligible
FROM panel p
JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
JOIN performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref
JOIN environment env ON pl.growregistry = env.arearegistry
GROUP BY panel_age
ORDER BY panel_age;
